# Clean Book

A hand-authored skills repository used as the accessibility fixture for this
site. Every document in it is deliberately free of accessibility defects, so
any violation axe reports against it is a defect in **our** rendering, not in
third-party content.

## What is in here

Three skills, chosen to exercise the three prose features most likely to
produce an accessibility failure: long prose with a repaired heading outline,
fenced code blocks with a scrollable region, and a data table.
